(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix AI evaluation."
application  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Name of the AI application this evaluation belongs to."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1

    markdown: "AI evaluation configuration."

    markdown: "Configuration for Allowed Topics evaluation."

    markdown: "AI evaluation ID."

    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Whether the evaluation is active."

    markdown: "Subsystem within the application."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
target  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Target span content the evaluation runs against. Can be one of [\"prompt\" \"response\"]."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["prompt" "response"]
threshold  Float64Attribute required
    markdown: "Score threshold. Must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive."
    validator: float64validator.betweenValidator value must be between 0.000000 and 1.000000
